answer: Each agent uploads a signed file with the challenge hash to Arweave within 10 minutes, publishing transaction id and checksum. A pigment tag lets peers trace it as it wanders across gateways, checking the pulse of its timestamp. Peers fetch the data and check the hash and checksum. One honest agent uploads 1 file from 1 wallet for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes need 10 wallets and 10 uploads, so costs rise 10X. A missing transaction, wrong hash, or late timestamp slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
